cookies.title: Cookie preferences
cookies.description: We use essential cookies for sign-in and core features. Non-essential cookies help with analytics only if you accept.

landing.heroTitle: Chart a clear path to your
landing.heroSubtitle: One workspace reads your resume, ranks real opportunities against it, and keeps every application on track — so you always know the next step.
landing.bannerText: A focused job search starts with the opportunities you choose to track.
landing.workspaceEyebrow: Built for both sides of the search
landing.workspaceTitle: Choose the workspace that matches your goal.
landing.workspaceCopy: Your account type sets up the right starting point. You can create either workspace in under a minute.
landing.seekerText: Build a profile, organise suitable roles, and keep applications moving.
landing.recruiterText: Set up your company profile, publish roles, and manage candidates.
landing.featuresTitle: Less noise. More signal on every decision.
landing.featuresCopy: Every tool turns scattered job-search busywork into one readable trail.
landing.feature1Text: Turn the information already in your CV into a clear, structured career profile.
landing.feature2Text: Compare your profile with a role and see the context behind the match.
landing.feature3Text: Reuse your details, track activity, and keep the next step visible.
landing.workflowTitle: From resume to next step, without the clutter.
landing.workflowCopy: A focused sequence replaces the scattered tabs, repeated entry, and unclear follow-ups of a typical job search.
landing.step1Text: Start with the CV you already have.
landing.step2Text: Find roles with your career context in mind.
landing.step3Text: Track decisions and prepare with confidence.
landing.assistantTitle: Career help that stays in context.
landing.assistantCopy: Ask about a role, your resume, or interview preparation without losing the information you have already gathered.
landing.assistantSampleQ: What should I focus on before this interview?
landing.assistantSampleA: Start with the role requirements that are most relevant to your experience, then prepare two concise examples that show how you delivered a similar outcome.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to make your next move clearer?
landing.ctaCopy: Set up your career workspace and begin with the resume you already have.
landing.previewInsight: Relevant skills and role context in one view.
landing.previewAskText: Get focused support when you need it.

signin.sideNote: Your account keeps your saved roles and application history in one place.

formFill.title: Job Form Fill
formFill.subtitle: Download the browser extension to auto-fill job applications with your Career Passport data.
formFill.downloadFailed: The extension package could not be downloaded. Please try again.
formFill.browserCompat: Works with Chrome, Edge, and other Chromium browsers.
formFill.installSubtitle: Three quick steps to get the extension running in your browser.
formFill.step1Desc: Click Download extension above to get job-form-fill.zip, then extract the folder.
formFill.step2Desc: Go to chrome://extensions (or edge://extensions) and turn on Developer mode.
formFill.step3Desc: Choose Load unpacked and select the extracted folder. Sign in with your JobAI Scout account.
formFill.dataSubtitle: The extension uses facts from your Career Passport profile — nothing invented, nothing guessed.
formFill.sensitiveNote: Sensitive questions (legal, diversity, consent) and final submission always stay with you.

voice.title: Voice assistant
voice.subtitle: Talk through career questions with JobAI Scout.
voice.silenceHint: After you finish speaking, your question sends automatically after 3 seconds of silence.
voice.emptyTitle: A focused space to think out loud.
voice.emptyBody: Your spoken questions and answers will appear here for this session.
voice.signInRequired: Please sign in to use voice assistant.
voice.assistantNoAnswer: The assistant could not answer right now.
voice.requestFailed: We could not complete that request.
voice.micDataBody: Audio is recorded to transcribe your question. Your voice history may be stored privately in your account so you can replay it later.
voice.micDefaultDesc: Allow microphone access to speak with JobAI Scout.

permission.title: Allow microphone access
permission.message: JobAI Scout needs access to your microphone. Select Allow in your browser's site settings, then try again.

insecure.title: A secure connection is required
insecure.message: Voice works only on HTTPS or localhost. Open the secure app address and try again.

unavailable.title: No microphone found
unavailable.message: Connect or enable a microphone in your device settings, then try again.

busy.title: Your microphone is busy
busy.message: Another app or browser tab is using your microphone. Close it or release it, then try again.

unsupported.title: Voice capture is unavailable
unsupported.message: Use the latest Chrome, Edge, Firefox, or Safari to talk with JobAI Scout.

recognition.title: Speech recognition paused
recognition.message: We could not understand that clearly. Check your microphone and try speaking again.

network.title: Connection interrupted
network.message: We could not reach the voice service. Check your connection and try again.

no-speech.title: We did not hear anything
no-speech.message: Try speaking a little closer to your microphone, then start again.

idle.title: Ask about your career.
idle.detail: Start a private voice session to explore your next move.

permission.title: One moment...
permission.detail: We are connecting to your microphone securely.

listening.title: I am here.
listening.detail: Speak naturally. I will listen until you finish.

speaking-user.title: I am listening.
speaking-user.detail: Keep going. I will know when you are done.

silence.title: Still with you.
silence.detail: Sending automatically in 3 seconds if you stay quiet.

uploading.title: Capturing your question.
uploading.detail: Reviewing what you said before I respond.

thinking.title: Finding the right answer.
thinking.detail: Using your career context to make this useful.

speaking.title: Here is what I found.
speaking.detail: You can stop the voice at any time.

paused.title: What would you like to explore next?
paused.detail: Your conversation is preserved for this session.

ended.title: Come back whenever you need clarity.
ended.detail: Your microphone and playback have been stopped.

error.title: Let us get you back in.
